method: Deterministic: each infeasible request is faithfully encoded as a spec, then validate()+critique() are run. A case passes if the system meets the expected minimum severity (error vs at-least-warning); it fails only if the system is SILENT. No agent, no key.

cases.name: negative_width
cases.prompt: a base cabinet minus 300 mm wide
cases.detail: [error] width: must be a positive, finite number, got -300

cases.name: zero_height
cases.detail: [error] height: must be a positive, finite number, got 0

cases.name: over_max_dimension
cases.detail: [error] width: exceeds the practical maximum of 6000mm

cases.name: too_many_shelves
cases.detail: [error] shelves: must be an integer 0–50, got 60

cases.name: drawer_taller_than_box
cases.prompt: a 400 mm tall base with a single 600 mm drawer front
cases.detail: [error] drawers: drawer fronts are taller than the available opening

cases.name: ten_drawers_in_720
cases.prompt: a 720 mm tall drawer base with ten 120 mm drawers
cases.detail: [error] drawers: drawer fronts are taller than the available opening

cases.name: five_shelves_in_200
cases.prompt: a 200 mm tall cabinet with five adjustable shelves
cases.concern: shelves cannot fit / no room to drill pins
cases.detail: [error] interference: 'Shelf 1' and 'Shelf 2' overlap (~2193.0 cm³) — they would not fit

cases.name: three_metre_single_cabinet
cases.prompt: a single base cabinet 3 metres wide
cases.concern: a part exceeds standard sheet stock
cases.detail: [warning] width: a 620×2964mm panel exceeds a standard 2440×1220 sheet; seam, use an oversize sheet, or resize

cases.name: wall_cabinet_with_toe_kick
cases.prompt: a wall cabinet with a toe kick
cases.concern: wall cabinets have no toe kick
cases.detail: [warning] toe_kick: wall cabinets hang on the wall and have no toe kick

cases.name: two_metre_deep_base
cases.detail: [warning] depth: unusually deep for a base cabinet
